questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Role of the Principal under the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws, 2018:
1. Provisions regarding the Role of Principal are incorporated under Rule 9.2 of the Affiliation Bye-Laws, 2018.
2. The Principal is required to hold staff meetings at least once a month to review monthly work and assess pupil progress.
3. In unaided schools, the Principal is completely prohibited from performing any duties of a Drawing and Disbursing Officer.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because Clause 9.2.4 specifies that in the case of an unaided school, the Principal may perform such functions as drawing and disbursing officer as may be specified in instructions issued by the Society.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि खंड 9.2.4 निर्दिष्ट करता है कि गैर-सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालय के मामले में, प्रधानाचार्य आहरण और संवितरण अधिकारी के रूप में ऐसे कार्य कर सकता है जो सोसाइटी द्वारा जारी निर्देशों में निर्दिष्ट किए जाएं।
key_facts: 9.2.4 Be the drawing and disbursing officer for the employees of the school however in the case of an unaided school, he may perform only such function, as drawing and disbursing officer as may be specified in the instructions issued by the Society.

सीबीएसई संबद्धता उप-नियमों के खंड 9.2 के तहत विद्यालय प्रमुख को सौंपे गए निम्नलिखित कर्तव्यों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. प्रत्येक छह महीने में कम से कम एक बार विद्यालय की संपत्ति और स्टॉक का भौतिक सत्यापन करना।
2. छात्रों के लिखित कार्य और गृहकार्य की जांच के लिए एक नियमित समय-सारणी की योजना बनाना और निर्दिष्ट करना।
3. हाउस प्रणाली या अन्य प्रभावी तरीकों से विभिन्न सह-पाठ्यचर्या गतिविधियों को व्यवस्थित और समन्वित करना।
4. अनौपचारिक और गैर-कक्षा शिक्षण की व्यवस्था करना।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following duties assigned to the Head of the School under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws:
1. Conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once every six months.
2. Plan and specify a regular time-table for the scrutiny of pupils' written work and home assignments.
3. Organize and coordinate various co-curricular activities through the house system or other effective ways.
4. Arrange for informal and non-class room teaching.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is incorrect because Clause 9.2.8 mandates physical verification of school property and stock 'at least once a year', not every six months. Statements 2 (Clause 9.2.19), 3 (Clause 9.2.21), and 4 (Clause 9.2.18) are all explicitly correct provisions of Clause 9.2.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि खंड 9.2.8 विद्यालय की संपत्ति और स्टॉक का भौतिक सत्यापन 'वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार' अनिवार्य करता है, न कि प्रत्येक छह महीने में। कथन 2 (खंड 9.2.19), 3 (खंड 9.2.21), और 4 (खंड 9.2.18) खंड 9.2 के स्पष्ट रूप से सही प्रावधान हैं।
key_facts: 9.2.8 Conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once a year and ensure the maintenance of stock registers neatly and accurately.

questions.question_hindi:
केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड (CBSE) के ऐतिहासिक विकास और प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. सैडलर कमीशन (Sadler Commission) से जुड़ी सिफारिशों के बाद 1929 में 'बोर्ड ऑफ हाई स्कूल एंड इंटरमीडिएट एजुकेशन, राजपूताना' की स्थापना की गई थी।
2. वर्ष 1952 में बोर्ड के संविधान में संशोधन किया गया, जिसके तहत इसके अधिकार क्षेत्र का विस्तार भाग-सी (Part-C) और भाग-डी (Part-D) क्षेत्रों में किया गया तथा इसे इसका वर्तमान नाम 'केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड' दिया गया।
3. वर्ष 1962 में बोर्ड के पुनर्गठन के परिणामस्वरूप तत्कालीन 'दिल्ली बोर्ड ऑफ सेकेंडरी एजुकेशन' का केंद्रीय बोर्ड में विलय कर दिया गया।
4. भारत के बाहर स्थित स्कूलों की देखरेख अजमेर स्थित क्षेत्रीय कार्यालय द्वारा की जाती है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the historical evolution and governance of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE):

1. The Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana was established in 1929 following recommendations related to the Sadler Commission.
2. In 1952, the constitution of the Board was amended, extending its jurisdiction to Part-C and Part-D territories and conferring its present name 'Central Board of Secondary Education'.
3. Upon the reconstitution of the Board in 1962, the erstwhile Delhi Board of Secondary Education was merged with the Central Board.
4. Schools located outside India are looked after by the Regional Office situated at Ajmer.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1, 2, and 3 are correct. Statement 4 is incorrect because according to the CBSE historical background, 'Schools located outside India are looked after by regional office Delhi', not Ajmer.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1, 2 और 3 सही हैं। कथन 4 गलत है क्योंकि सीबीएसई के आधिकारिक विवरण के अनुसार, 'भारत के बाहर स्थित स्कूलों की देखरेख क्षेत्रीय कार्यालय दिल्ली द्वारा की जाती है', न कि अजमेर द्वारा।
key_facts: Schools located outside India are looked after by regional office Delhi.

questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Year / Milestone in CBSE's History) with List-II (Key Historical Development) according to the official records of the Board:

List-I:
A. 1921
B. 1929
C. 1941
D. 1962

List-II:
1. Reconstitution of the Board and shifting of Headquarters to Delhi
2. Establishment of a Post-Graduate Training College for Teachers in Ajmer
3. Setting up of U.P. Board of High School and Intermediate Education
4. Establishment of the Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana

Select the correct code:
questions.explanation_english: 1921: U P Board of High School and Intermediate Education was the first Board set up. 1929: Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana established. 1941: Establishment of a Post-Graduate Training College for Teachers in Ajmer under Chairman Dr. I.C. Chatterjee. 1962: Reconstitution of the Board and shifting of HQ at Delhi.
questions.explanation_hindi: 1921: यू.पी. बोर्ड ऑफ हाई स्कूल एंड इंटरमीडिएट एजुकेशन पहला स्थापित बोर्ड था। 1929: बोर्ड ऑफ हाई स्कूल एंड इंटरमीडिएट एजुकेशन, राजपूताना की स्थापना हुई। 1941: तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष डॉ. आई.सी. चटर्जी की पहल पर अजमेर में शिक्षकों के लिए स्नातकोत्तर प्रशिक्षण महाविद्यालय की स्थापना की गई। 1962: बोर्ड का पुनर्गठन हुआ और मुख्यालय दिल्ली स्थानांतरित हुआ।
key_facts: U P Board of High School and Intermediate Education was the first Board set up in 1921... questions.question_hindi: बोर्ड ऑफ हाई स्कूल एंड इंटरमीडिएट एजुकेशन, राजपूताना (अजमेर) के ऐतिहासिक तथ्यों और स्थापत्य विवरण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?

स्थापना (1929) के समय नियंत्रक प्राधिकारी (Controlling Authority) : लेफ्टिनेंट कर्नल जी.डी. ओगिल्वी (Lt Col. G.D. Ogilvie)

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the decentralization and administration of CBSE:

questions.question_hindi:
CBSE संबद्धता उप-नियमों के तहत विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) के मापदंडों (सूची-I) को अध्याय 8 के तहत अनिवार्य मानक/सीमा (सूची-II) के साथ सुमेलित कीजिए:

सूची-I:
A. निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालय में SMC की अधिकतम संख्या
B. मान्यता प्राप्त सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालय में SMC की अधिकतम संख्या
C. SMC में महिलाओं का न्यूनतम अनिवार्य प्रतिनिधित्व
D. SMC के सदस्यों का सामान्य कार्यकाल

नीचे दिए गए कूट का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Parameter of School Management Committee under CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws) with List-II (Mandated Norm / Limit under Chapter 8): 

List-I:
A. Maximum strength of SMC in a private unaided school
B. Maximum strength of SMC in a recognized aided school
C. Minimum mandatory representation of women in the SMC
D. Standard term of office of the members of the SMC

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english:
According to Chapter 8 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws:
- Clause 8.2.1: The management committee of a recognized aided school shall consist of not more than fifteen members (B-1); private unaided school shall consist of not more than twenty-one members (A-2).
- Clause 8.2.2(h): At least fifty percent members should be women (C-3).
- Clause 8.3: The term of the members of the Management Committee shall be three years (D-4).
Thus, the correct code is A-2, B-1, C-3, D-4.
questions.explanation_hindi:
CBSE संबद्धता उप-नियमों के अध्याय 8 के अनुसार:
- खंड 8.2.1: मान्यता प्राप्त सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालय की प्रबंधन समिति में 15 से अधिक सदस्य नहीं होंगे (B-1); निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालय की प्रबंधन समिति में 21 से अधिक सदस्य नहीं होंगे (A-2)।
- खंड 8.2.2(h): कम से कम पचास प्रतिशत सदस्य महिलाएं होनी चाहिए (C-3)।
- खंड 8.3: प्रबंधन समिति के सदस्यों का कार्यकाल तीन वर्ष होगा (D-4)।
अतः सही कूट A-2, B-1, C-3, D-4 है।
key_facts: 8.2.1 The management committee of a recognized aided school shall consist of not more than fifteen members: and the management committee of a private unaided school shall consist of not more than twenty one members ... (h) At least fifty percent members should be women ... 8.3 The term of the members of the Management Committee shall be three years.

questions.question_hindi: केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड (CBSE) की वित्त समिति (Finance Committee) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
options_hindi: वित्त समिति बोर्ड के वित्त से संबंधित सभी मामलों में एक सलाहकार निकाय के रूप में कार्य करती है।
बोर्ड का वित्तीय विवरण और वार्षिक बजट अनुमान पहले वित्त समिति के समक्ष प्रस्तुत किया जाएगा।
वित्त समिति में नियंत्रक प्राधिकारी (कंट्रोलिंग अथॉरिटी) के दो नामित सदस्य शामिल होते हैं।
बोर्ड का सचिव वित्त समिति के सचिव के रूप में कार्य करता है।
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Which of the following statements regarding the Finance Committee of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is NOT correct?
options_english: The Finance Committee acts as an Advisory Body in all matters concerning the finances of the Board.
The financial statement and the annual budget estimates of the Board shall first be laid before the Finance Committee.
The Finance Committee comprises two nominees of the Controlling Authority.
The Secretary of the Board acts as the Secretary of the Finance Committee.
questions.explanation_english: The statement claiming that the Finance Committee comprises two nominees of the Controlling Authority is incorrect. According to the official composition, the Finance Committee consists of: (a) The Chairman; (b) One nominee of the Controlling Authority; (c) Two members of the Board elected by the Board; and (d) The Secretary of the Board who acts as the Secretary of the Committee.
questions.explanation_hindi: यह कथन कि वित्त समिति में नियंत्रक प्राधिकारी के दो नामित सदस्य शामिल होते हैं, गलत है। आधिकारिक संरचना के अनुसार, वित्त समिति में निम्नलिखित शामिल हैं: (a) अध्यक्ष; (b) नियंत्रक प्राधिकारी का एक नामित सदस्य; (c) बोर्ड द्वारा चुने गए बोर्ड के दो सदस्य; और (d) बोर्ड का सचिव, जो समिति के सचिव के रूप में कार्य करेगा।
key_facts: The Finance Committee shall act as an Advisory Body in all matters concerning the finances of the Board. The financial statement and the annual budget estimates of the Board shall first be laid before the Finance Committee and then submitted to the Board with its recommendations. The Composition of the Finance Committee is as under: (a) The Chairman; (b) One nominee of the Controlling Authority; and (c) Two members of the Board elected by the Board. (d) The Secretary of the Board shall act as the Secretary of the Committee

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the powers and functions of the School Management Committee (SMC) under Clause 8.4 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws:

1. It shall make appointment of teachers and non-teaching staff.
2. It shall exercise financial powers beyond those delegated to the Principal within the budgetary provisions of the school.
3. It shall take stock of academic programmes and progress of the school without jeopardizing the academic freedom of the Principal.

questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct under Clause 8.4 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws. questions.explanation_hindi: CBSE संबद्धता उप-नियमों के खंड 8.4 के तहत तीनों कथन सही हैं। खंड 8.4.5, 8.4.6 और 8.4.7 के अनुसार: यह शिक्षकों और गैर-शिक्षण कर्मचारियों की नियुक्ति करेगी; यह विद्यालय के बजटीय प्रावधानों के भीतर प्रधानाचार्य को प्रत्यायोजित शक्तियों से परे वित्तीय शक्तियों का प्रयोग करेगी; और यह प्रधानाचार्य की शैक्षणिक स्वतंत्रता से समझौता किए बिना विद्यालय के शैक्षणिक कार्यक्रमों और प्रगति का जायजा लेगी।
key_facts: 8.4.5 It shall make appointment of teachers and non teaching staff. 8.4.6 It shall exercise financial powers beyond those delegated to the Principal within the budgetary provisions of the school. 8.4.7 It shall take stock of academic Programmes and progress of the school without jeopardizing the academic freedom of Principal.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the age criteria and relaxations for the post of Principal in the Education Department, GNCTD under UPSC Special Advertisement No. 51/2026:

1. The upper age limit is 50 years for Unreserved (UR) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS).

questions.explanation_english: According to Special Advertisement No. 51/2026, the age limit is 50 years for UR/EWS, 53 years for OBC, and 55 years for SC/ST. Furthermore, age is relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD candidates subject to the maximum age limit of 56 years.
questions.explanation_hindi: विशेष विज्ञापन संख्या 51/2026 के अनुसार, यूआर/ईडब्ल्यूएस के लिए आयु सीमा 50 वर्ष, ओबीसी के लिए 53 वर्ष और एससी/एसटी के लिए 55 वर्ष है। इसके अलावा, पीडब्ल्यूबीडी उम्मीदवारों के लिए आयु में 10 वर्ष तक की छूट अधिकतम 56 वर्ष की सीमा के अधीन प्रदान की गई है।

3. Under category (d), Specific Learning Disability (SLD) and Mental Illness (MI) are marked as suitable with reservation, whereas Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Intellectual Disability (ID) are marked as NOT suitable.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct: (1) Total vacancies are 124 (72 Male, 52 Female). (2) Seven vacancies are reserved for PwBD candidates (5 fresh, 2 backlog). (3) Under category (d), ASD and ID have 'No' for Suitability and Reservation, while SLD and MI have 'Yes' for both Suitability and Reservation.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं: (1) कुल रिक्तियां 124 हैं (72 पुरुष, 52 महिला)। (2) पीडब्ल्यूबीडी उम्मीदवारों के लिए 7 रिक्तियां आरक्षित हैं (5 नई, 2 बैकलॉग)। (3) श्रेणी (d) के तहत, ASD और ID के लिए उपयुक्तता और आरक्षण 'No' है, जबकि SLD और MI के लिए उपयुक्तता और आरक्षण दोनों 'Yes' हैं।
key_facts: Out of one hundred twenty four vacancies, seven vacancies are reserved for candidates belonging to category of persons with benchmark disability (PwBD). Out of seven vacancies, which are reserved for PwBD candidates, five vacancies are fresh vacancies and two vacancies are backlog vacancies.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Sub-clauses of Clause 9.2 of CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws) with List-II (Mandated Role/Duty of the Principal):

List-I:
A. Clause 9.2.8
B. Clause 9.2.9
C. Clause 9.2.13
D. Clause 9.2.17

List-II:
1. Conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once a year
2. Be responsible for proper utilization of the Pupils Fund

2. खंड 9.2.16 के अनुसार, प्रिंसिपल को कक्षा शिक्षण का पर्यवेक्षण करना चाहिए तथा समान विषय क्षेत्रों के शिक्षकों के बीच सहयोग और समन्वय के साथ-साथ अंतर-विषय समन्वय भी सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए।
3. खंड 9.2.18 के अनुसार, औपचारिक पाठ्यचर्या संबंधी गतिविधियों पर विशेष ध्यान सुनिश्चित करने के लिए प्रिंसिपल को अनौपचारिक और गैर-कक्षा शिक्षण आयोजित करने से स्पष्ट रूप से प्रतिबंधित किया गया है।
4. खंड 9.2.19 के अनुसार, प्रिंसिपल को छात्रों के लिखित कार्य और गृह असाइनमेंट की जांच के लिए एक नियमित समय सारिणी की योजना और विनिर्देशन करना होगा।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the academic supervision and curriculum responsibilities of the Principal under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws, consider the following statements:

1. As per Clause 9.2.12, the Principal is in-charge of admissions, timetable preparation, duty allocation, and conduct of school examinations in accordance with instructions issued by the Government/Board.
2. As per Clause 9.2.16, the Principal must supervise classroom teaching and secure co-operation and coordination amongst teachers of the same subject areas as well as inter-subject coordination.
3. As per Clause 9.2.18, the Principal is explicitly barred from conducting informal and non-classroom teaching to ensure sole focus on formal curricular activities.
4. As per Clause 9.2.19, the Principal must plan and specify a regular timetable for the scrutiny of pupils' written work and home assignments.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1, 2, and 4 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because Clause 9.2.18 specifically mandates the Principal to 'Arrange for informal and non-class room teaching', rather than barring it.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1, 2 और 4 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि खंड 9.2.18 विशेष रूप से प्रिंसिपल को 'अनौपचारिक और गैर-कक्षा शिक्षण की व्यवस्था करने' (Arrange for informal and non-class room teaching) का निर्देश देता है, न कि इसे प्रतिबंधित करता है।
key_facts: 9.2.12 Be in-charge of admission in the school, preparation of school timetable, allocation of duties and teaching load to the teachers, and shall provide necessary facilities to the teachers for the discharge of their duties and conduct of school examination in accordance with the instructions issued by the Government /Board from time to time; 9.2.16 Supervise class room teaching and secure co-operation and coordination amongst teachers of the same subject areas as well as inter subject coordination. 9.2.18 Arrange for informal and non-class room teaching. 9.2.19 Plan and specify a regular time-table for the scrutiny of pupils written work and home assignment and ensure that the assessment and corrections are carried out timely and effectively.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the evaluation reforms and historical assessment studies in Indian school examination boards, consider the following statements:

1. In April 2017, a joint decision was taken by all 40 major examination boards of India to eliminate excessive marks inflation practiced in the garb of 'moderation'.
2. The perils of relying on raw marks were flagged as early as 1971 in a report headed by A. E. T. Barrow, the then secretary of the CISCE.
3. Following the 2017 decision, Punjab's high-school board exam pass rate plunged sharply from 67 percent to 30 percent.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because in 2017, the pass rate plunged from 67 percent to 30 percent in Bihar's science stream, whereas in Punjab it fell by 15 percentage points, from 77 percent to 62 percent.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि 2017 में बिहार के विज्ञान संकाय में उत्तीर्ण दर 67 प्रतिशत से गिरकर 30 प्रतिशत हुई थी, जबकि पंजाब में यह 15 प्रतिशत गिरकर 77 से 62 प्रतिशत हुई थी।
key_facts: After a joint decision in April 2017 by all the 40 major exam boards of India to do away with this form of moderation, the state boards that actually implemented the decision—like Bihar and Punjab in the above examples—saw dramatic falls in pass rates... In 2016, the high-school pass rate in Bihar’s state school-leaving board exam was 67 percent for the science stream; in 2017, it plunged to 30 percent. In Punjab, meanwhile, the high-school pass rate fell by 15 percentage points, from 77 to 62 percent, over the same period... Many perils of using raw marks had been flagged as early as 1971, in a report on the scaling and moderation of scores. That study was headed by A. E. T. Barrow, the then secretary of the CISCE

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the direct recruitment of Principals in Delhi government schools and the recruitment pattern handled by UPSC:

1. In the previous direct recruitment cycle, 58 Principals took their written exam in 2012 and joined schools in 2015 after a recruitment process that began in 2010.
2. In July 2022, UPSC conducted a recruitment test for 363 posts of Principals for Delhi government schools.
3. The UPSC assesses candidates for the post of Principal across six subject areas, including management and financial administration and office procedure.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct based on the official communication by Deputy CM Manish Sisodia to the UPSC Chairman in July 2022: the previous batch of 58 principals took the written test in 2012 and joined in 2015 (process 2010-2015); the July 2022 test was for 363 posts; and the UPSC tests candidates across six specified areas including management, financial administration, and office procedure.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं: 58 प्रधानाचार्यों के पिछले बैच ने 2012 में लिखित परीक्षा दी और 2015 में स्कूलों में पदभार संभाला (2010-2015 प्रक्रिया); जुलाई 2022 की परीक्षा 363 पदों के लिए थी; तथा यूपीएससी छह निर्धारित विषय-क्षेत्रों में उम्मीदवारों का मूल्यांकन करता है जिसमें प्रबंधन, वित्तीय प्रशासन और कार्यालय प्रक्रिया शामिल हैं।
key_facts: The deputy CM wrote that July 17 will be a historical day for the education system of India because conducting the recruitment test for 363 posts by the UPSC is going to be the biggest exercise in strengthening the school system since the adoption of National Education Policy... It is to be noted that UPSC examines a candidate for post of principals on six subject matters which includes general knowledge, language skills, reasoning and aptitude, education policies and evaluation, management and financial administration and office procedure... The previous batch of 58 Principals took their written exam in 2012 and joined the schools in 2015 after the completion of recruitment process that began in 2010 and completed in 2015.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the correspondence sent by the Government of NCT of Delhi to the UPSC in July 2022 regarding the recruitment of school principals, consider the following statements:

1. The communication was formally addressed to UPSC Chairman Manoj Soni.
2. The recruitment test for 363 principal posts was termed the biggest exercise in strengthening the school system since the adoption of the National Education Policy.
3. The Deputy Chief Minister highlighted that significant changes had taken place in the country's education system during the seven-year span between 2015 and 2022.
4. The selection panel was urged to select candidates displaying respect for Delhi's culture and diversity, understanding of Delhi's ground realities, and a research-oriented mindset.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All four statements are correct based on the communication sent by Deputy Chief Minister Manish Sisodia to UPSC Chairman Manoj Soni. He highlighted that the recruitment test for 363 posts was the biggest exercise since the adoption of the NEP, noted the changes between 2015 and 2022, and outlined key qualities needed including respect for Delhi's culture and diversity, understanding of ground realities, and a research-oriented mindset.
questions.explanation_hindi: उपमुख्यमंत्री मनीष सिसोदिया द्वारा यूपीएससी अध्यक्ष मनोज सोनी को भेजे गए पत्र के अनुसार चारों कथन सही हैं। उन्होंने रेखांकित किया कि 363 पदों के लिए यह परीक्षा NEP को अपनाने के बाद सबसे बड़ा अभ्यास था, 2015 और 2022 के बीच आए बदलावों को दर्ज किया, तथा दिल्ली की संस्कृति और विविधता के प्रति सम्मान, जमीनी हकीकत की समझ और शोधपरक दृष्टिकोण जैसी अनिवार्य योग्यताओं पर बल दिया।
key_facts: Deputy Chief Minister Manish Sisodia on Wednesday wrote to the commission chairman Manoj Soni suggesting that they should also look out for their larger abilities and deep understanding of child behaviour. The deputy CM wrote that July 17 will be a historical day for the education system of India because conducting the recruitment test for 363 posts by the UPSC is going to be the biggest exercise in strengthening the school system since the adoption of National Education Policy. He further wrote that many significant changes have taken place in the country’s education system in the past seven years, between 2015 and 2022. Manish Sisodia requested UPSC should also look out for qualities and abilities like his/her belief in every child and his/her abilities to learn, respect for Delhi’s culture and diversity, understanding of ground realities of Delhi, ability to inspire and mentor teachers, owns a research-oriented mindset and is willing to read and learn.

With reference to the statutory duties of the Head of the School under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye Laws, 2018, consider the following statements:

1. The Head of the School/Principal is the ex-officio Member Secretary of the School Management Committee.
2. The Principal is required to conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once every quarter.
3. The Principal must hold staff meetings at least once a month to review the work done and assess the progress of the pupils.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english:
Under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye Laws, 2018:
- Clause 9.2.1 states that the Head of the School/Principal will be the ex-officio Member Secretary of the School Management Committee (Statement 1 is correct).
- Clause 9.2.8 states that the Principal must conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once a year, not quarterly (Statement 2 is incorrect).
- Clause 9.2.13 states that the Principal must hold staff meetings at least once a month to review work and assess progress (Statement 3 is correct).

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Centrally Sponsored Scheme of PM SHRI Schools (PM ScHools for Rising India):

1. It involves the establishment of entirely new greenfield schools across the country rather than strengthening existing institutions.
2. The scheme carries a total project cost of Rs. 27,360 crore, which includes a central share of Rs. 18,128 crore.
3. PM SHRI Schools are mandated to act as exemplar schools and offer mentorship to other schools in their vicinity.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is incorrect because PM SHRI is designed for 'strengthening select existing schools being managed by Central Government/ State/ UT Government/ local bodies', not establishing new greenfield schools. Statements 2 and 3 are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि पीएम श्री योजना 'केंद्र सरकार/राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश सरकार/स्थानीय निकायों द्वारा प्रबंधित चुनिंदा मौजूदा स्कूलों को मजबूत करके' विकसित की जा रही है, न कि नए ग्रीनफील्ड स्कूल स्थापित करके। कथन 2 और 3 सही हैं।
key_facts: This will be a new scheme for development of more than 14500 schools across the country as PM SHRI Schools by strengthening select existing schools being managed by Central Government/ State/ UT Government/ local bodies. PM SHRI Schools will showcase all components of the National Education Policy 2020, act as exemplar schools and also offer mentorship to other schools in their vicinity.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the duties and functions of the Head of the School under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws:

1. The Principal is in-charge of admission in the school, preparation of school timetable, and allocation of teaching load to teachers.
2. The Principal is mandated to arrange for informal and non-classroom teaching.
3. The Principal must organize and coordinate co-curricular activities exclusively through external agencies rather than the house system.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct as per Clause 9.2.12 and 9.2.18. Statement 3 is incorrect because Clause 9.2.21 specifies that the Head of the School shall 'Organize and coordinate various co-curricular activities through the house system or in such other effective ways as he may think fit', not exclusively through external agencies.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 क्लॉज 9.2.12 और 9.2.18 के अनुसार सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि क्लॉज 9.2.21 निर्दिष्ट करता है कि स्कूल प्रमुख 'Organize and coordinate various co-curricular activities through the house system or in such other effective ways as he may think fit' करेंगे, न कि केवल बाहरी एजेंसियों के माध्यम से।
key_facts: 9.2.12 Be in-charge of admission in the school, preparation of school timetable, allocation of duties and teaching load to the teachers, and shall provide necessary facilities to the teachers for the discharge of their duties and conduct of school examination in accordance with the instructions issued by the Government /Board from time to time; 9.2.18 Arrange for informal and non-class room teaching. 9.2.21 Organize and coordinate various co-curricular activities through the house system or in such other effective ways as he may think fit.

questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Clause of CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws under Clause 9.2) with List-II (Mandated Role/Duty of the Principal):

A. Clause 9.2.6

4. Make satisfactory arrangements for supply of good drinking water and maintain school property

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english:
Matching correctly:
- Clause 9.2.6: Handle official correspondence relating to the school and furnish returns/information (2)
- Clause 9.2.10: Make satisfactory arrangements for drinking water and proper maintenance of school properties (4)
- Clause 9.2.14: Help and guide teachers to promote their professional growth and encourage participation in in-service education (3)
- Clause 9.2.19: Plan and specify a regular time-table for scrutiny of pupils' written work and home assignment (1).

questions.explanation_hindi:
सही सुमेलन:
- क्लॉज 9.2.6: आधिकारिक पत्राचार और रिटर्न/जानकारी प्रस्तुत करना (2)
- क्लॉज 9.2.10: पेयजल व्यवस्था और स्कूल संपत्ति का रखरखाव (4)
- क्लॉज 9.2.14: शिक्षकों के व्यावसायिक विकास और सेवाकालीन शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देना (3)
- क्लॉज 9.2.19: लिखित कार्य व गृहकार्य की जांच हेतु नियमित समय-सारणी (1)।

questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs regarding the statutory obligations of the Head of the School under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws is NOT correctly matched?

questions.question_hindi:

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the early history and establishment of the predecessor body of CBSE:

1. It was set up following the recommendations of the Calcutta University Commission (1917–19), popularly known as the Sadler Commission.
2. In 1929, the 'Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana' had its headquarters established at Ajmer with a total membership of 38.
3. The Controlling Authority of the Board at the time of its establishment was Lt Col. G.D. Ogilvie.
4. In 1941, the Board established a Post-Graduate Training College for Teachers in Ajmer under the initiative of Dr. I.C. Chatterjee.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All four statements are correct based on the historical records of CBSE. The Calcutta University Commission (Sadler Commission) triggered the setup of secondary boards. In 1929, the Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana was established at Ajmer with Lt Col. G.D. Ogilvie as Controlling Authority and 38 members. In 1941, under Chairman Dr. I.C. Chatterjee, a Post-Graduate Training College for Teachers was established at Ajmer.
questions.explanation_hindi: CBSE के ऐतिहासिक विवरण के अनुसार सभी चारों कथन सही हैं। कलकत्ता विश्वविद्यालय आयोग (सैडलर आयोग) के कारण माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्डों की स्थापना शुरू हुई। 1929 में, बोर्ड ऑफ हाई स्कूल एंड इंटरमीडिएट एजुकेशन, राजपूताना की स्थापना अजमेर में लेफ्टिनेंट कर्नल जी.डी. ओगिल्वी (नियंत्रक प्राधिकारी) और 38 सदस्यों के साथ हुई। 1941 में, तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष डॉ. आई.सी. चटर्जी की पहल पर अजमेर में शिक्षकों के लिए एक पोस्ट-ग्रेजुएट ट्रेनिंग कॉलेज की स्थापना की गई थी।
key_facts: As such the Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana including Ajmer-Merwara, Central India and Gwalior was established in 1929 by a resolution of the Government of India. The Board, as constituted under that resolution, had its headquarters at Ajmer with the agent to the Governor-General in Rajputana and Chief Commissioner, Ajmer-Merwara, Lt Col. G.D. Ogilvie, as the Controlling Authority and a total membership of 38 including representatives of the administered areas and States within its jurisdiction.

Match List-I (Milestone Year in CBSE History) with List-II (Key Event / Development):

List-I:
A. 1921
B. 1929
C. 1952
D. 1962

List-II:
1. The Board was reconstituted, HQ shifted to Delhi, and erstwhile Delhi Board was merged
2. First Board of High School and Intermediate Education set up in U.P.
3. Establishment of Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana with HQ at Ajmer

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english: As per CBSE historical records: 1921 marks the setup of the U.P. Board of High School and Intermediate Education; 1929 marks the establishment of the Rajputana Board; 1952 is when the constitution was amended, extended to Part-C and Part-D territories, and named 'Central Board of Secondary Education'; and 1962 is when the Board was reconstituted and HQ shifted to Delhi.
questions.explanation_hindi: CBSE के ऐतिहासिक रिकॉर्ड के अनुसार: 1921 में यू.पी. बोर्ड की स्थापना हुई; 1929 में राजपूताना बोर्ड की स्थापना हुई; 1952 में संविधान संशोधित कर क्षेत्राधिकार पार्ट-सी और पार्ट-डी क्षेत्रों में बढ़ाया गया तथा 'केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड' नाम दिया गया; और 1962 में बोर्ड का पुनर्गठन किया गया और मुख्यालय दिल्ली स्थानांतरित हुआ।
key_facts: U P Board of High School and Intermediate Education was the first Board set up in 1921... suggested to set up a joint Board in 1929 for all the areas which was named as the 'Board of High School and Intermediate Education, Rajputana'... As a result of this, in 1952, the constitution of the Board was amended wherein its jurisdiction was extended to part-C and Part-D territories and the Board was given its present name 'Central Board of Secondary Education'. It was in the year 1962 finally that the Board was reconstituted.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to Chapter 8 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws regarding the School Management Committee (SMC), consider the following statements:

1. The management committee of a recognized aided school shall consist of not more than fifteen members, and that of a private unaided school shall consist of not more than twenty-one members.
2. The Head of the school shall serve as the Chairperson of the School Management Committee.
3. At least fifty percent of the members of the School Management Committee should be women.
4. The term of the members of the Management Committee shall be three years, and a member cannot remain in office for more than two consecutive terms except ex-officio members and members of the Trust/Society/Company.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is correct as per Clause 8.2.1. Statement 2 is incorrect because Clause 8.2.2(a) states that the Head of the school will be the Member Secretary, not the Chairperson. Statement 3 is correct as per Clause 8.2.2(h) ('At least fifty percent members should be women'). Statement 4 is correct as per Clause 8.3 ('The term of the members of the Management Committee shall be three years. A member can be re-nominated for another term but a member cannot remain in office for more than two consecutive terms except ex-officio members and the members of the Trust/Society/Company').
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 खंड 8.2.1 के अनुसार सही है। कथन 2 गलत है क्योंकि खंड 8.2.2(a) के अनुसार स्कूल का प्रमुख सदस्य सचिव (Member Secretary) होगा, अध्यक्ष नहीं। कथन 3 खंड 8.2.2(h) के अनुसार सही है ('कम से कम पचास प्रतिशत सदस्य महिलाएं होनी चाहिए')। कथन 4 खंड 8.3 के अनुसार सही है ('प्रबंधन समिति के सदस्यों का कार्यकाल तीन वर्ष होगा... पदेन सदस्यों और ट्रस्ट/सोसाइटी/कंपनी के सदस्यों को छोड़कर कोई भी सदस्य लगातार दो कार्यकालों से अधिक पद पर नहीं रह सकता')।
key_facts: 8.2.1 The management committee of a recognized aided school shall consist of not more than fifteen members: and the management committee of a private unaided school shall consist of not more than twenty one members; ... (a) The Head of the school. S/he will be a Member Secretary of the School Management Committee: ... (h) At least fifty percent members should be women ... 8.3 The term of the members of the Management Committee shall be three years. A member can be re-nominated for another term but a member cannot remain in office for more than two consecutive terms except ex-officio members and the members of the Trust/Society/Company.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the duties and role of the Principal/Head of School under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws, 2018:

1. The Principal is responsible for conducting physical verification of school property and stock at least once a year.
2. The Principal is responsible for the proper utilization of the Pupils Fund.
3. The Principal must plan the year's academic work in advance and hold staff meetings at least once a fortnight.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Clause 9.2.8 specifies physical verification at least once a year, and 9.2.9 specifies responsibility for proper utilization of the Pupils Fund. Statement 3 is incorrect because Clause 9.2.13 states: 'hold staff meeting at least once a month', not once a fortnight.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। खंड 9.2.8 वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार भौतिक सत्यापन का प्रावधान करता है, और 9.2.9 प्यूपिल्स फंड के समुचित उपयोग का दायित्व तय करता है। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि खंड 9.2.13 में 'कम से कम महीने में एक बार स्टाफ बैठक आयोजित करने' का उल्लेख है, न कि पाक्षिक।
key_facts: 9.2.8 Conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once a year and ensure the maintenance of stock registers neatly and accurately. 9.2.9 Be responsible for proper utilization of the Pupils Fund. 9.2.13 Plan the year’s academic work in advance in consultation with his colleagues and hold staff meeting at least once a month, review the work done during the month and assess the progress of the pupils.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Year of High-School Board Exam) with List-II (Pass Rate Percentage in Uttar Pradesh) as documented in the study on exam moderation and assessment standards:

List-I:
A. 1991
B. 1992
C. 2007
D. 2013

List-II:
1. 57.0%
2. 14.7%
3. 74.4%
4. 86.6%

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english: As documented in Table 1 ('Pass rates in the Uttar Pradesh high-school board exam') of the ORF research: in 1991 the pass rate was 57.0%; in 1992 (when police were deployed to curb cheating) it plummeted to 14.7%; in 2007 it was 74.4%; and in 2013 it reached 86.6%. Thus, A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4 is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: ओआरएफ शोध की तालिका 1 ('उत्तर प्रदेश हाई-स्कूल बोर्ड परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण दर') के अनुसार: 1991 में उत्तीर्ण दर 57.0% थी; 1992 में (जब नकल रोकने के लिए पुलिस तैनात की गई थी) यह गिरकर 14.7% हो गई थी; 2007 में यह 74.4% थी; और 2013 में यह 86.6% थी। अतः A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4 सही सुमेलित है।
key_facts:
Table 1: Pass rates in the Uttar Pradesh high-school board exam
| Year | Percentage of exam takers who passed | Political party in power |
| 1991 | 57.0 | Janata Dal |
| 1992 | 14.7 | BJP* |
| 2007 | 74.4 | SP |
| 2013 | 86.6 | SP |

questions.question_hindi: 2017 के मॉडरेशन-विरोधी निर्णय के बाद प्रलेखित बोर्ड परीक्षा परिणाम प्रवृत्तियों और घटनाक्रमों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
options_hindi: उत्तीर्ण दर में भारी गिरावट पर मुख्यमंत्री द्वारा इस्तीफा देने का दबाव : बिहार स्कूल परीक्षा बोर्ड के प्रमुख
बिहार बोर्ड हाई-स्कूल विज्ञान उत्तीर्ण दर (2016) : 67 प्रतिशत
2016 से 2017 तक पंजाब हाई-स्कूल उत्तीर्ण दर में गिरावट : 15 प्रतिशत अंक
बिहार बोर्ड हाई-स्कूल विज्ञान उत्तीर्ण दर (2017) : 30 प्रतिशत
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs regarding the board examination pass rate trends and immediate fallout documented after the 2017 anti-moderation decision is NOT correctly matched?
options_english: Board chief pressured by Chief Minister to resign over plunged pass rate : Bihar School Examination Board
Bihar board high-school science pass rate (2016) : 67 percent
Drop in Punjab high-school pass rate from 2016 to 2017 : 15 percentage points
Bihar board high-school science pass rate (2017) : 30 percent
questions.explanation_english: Pair D is NOT correctly matched. The context states that in Punjab, the high-school pass rate fell by 15 percentage points (from 77 to 62 percent), and the head of the Punjab school exam board was pressured by the chief minister to resign, not the head of the Bihar board.
questions.explanation_hindi: युग्म D सही सुमेलित नहीं है। संदर्भ के अनुसार, पंजाब में हाई-स्कूल उत्तीर्ण दर 15 प्रतिशत अंक (77 से गिरकर 62 प्रतिशत) कम हो गई थी, और पंजाब स्कूल परीक्षा बोर्ड के प्रमुख को मुख्यमंत्री द्वारा इस्तीफा देने के लिए विवश किया गया था, न कि बिहार बोर्ड के प्रमुख को।
key_facts: In 2016, the high-school pass rate in Bihar’s state school-leaving board exam was 67 percent for the science stream; in 2017, it plunged to 30 percent. [2] In Punjab, meanwhile, the high-school pass rate fell by 15 percentage points, from 77 to 62 percent, over the same period. [3] ... Some people have been held accountable for this: for instance, the head of the Punjab school exam board was pressured by the chief minister to resign

questions.question_hindi:
दिल्ली के सरकारी स्कूलों के लिए यूपीएससी (UPSC) द्वारा स्कूल प्रधानाचार्यों की सीधी भर्ती के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. यूपीएससी प्रधानाचार्य पद के लिए उम्मीदवार का परीक्षण छह विषयों पर करती है, जिसमें शिक्षा नीतियां और मूल्यांकन तथा कार्यालय प्रक्रिया शामिल हैं।
2. वर्ष 2022 की परीक्षा से पहले के भर्ती चक्र में, 58 प्रधानाचार्यों के एक बैच ने 2012 में अपनी लिखित परीक्षा दी थी और 2015 में स्कूलों में कार्यभार ग्रहण किया था।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the direct recruitment of school principals by the UPSC for Delhi government schools:

1. The UPSC examines a candidate for the post of principal on six subject matters, including education policies and evaluation, and office procedure.
2. In the recruitment cycle prior to the 2022 examination, a batch of 58 principals took their written examination in 2012 and joined schools in 2015.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct according to official particulars: UPSC examines candidates for the post of principals across six subject matters (general knowledge, language skills, reasoning and aptitude, education policies and evaluation, management and financial administration, and office procedure). Prior to the July 2022 test for 363 posts, direct recruitment had happened a decade earlier, where a batch of 58 Principals took their written exam in 2012 and joined schools in 2015.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं: यूपीएससी प्रधानाचार्य पद के लिए छह विषय-वस्तुओं (सामान्य ज्ञान, भाषा कौशल, तर्क और योग्यता, शिक्षा नीतियां और मूल्यांकन, प्रबंधन और वित्तीय प्रशासन, और कार्यालय प्रक्रिया) पर उम्मीदवारों का परीक्षण करती है। जुलाई 2022 में 363 पदों की परीक्षा से पहले, सीधी भर्ती एक दशक पहले हुई थी, जिसमें 58 प्रधानाचार्यों के बैच ने 2012 में लिखित परीक्षा दी थी और 2015 में स्कूलों में पदभार ग्रहण किया था।
key_facts: It is to be noted that UPSC examines a candidate for post of principals on six subject matters which includes general knowledge, language skills, reasoning and aptitude, education policies and evaluation, management and financial administration and office procedure. ... Direct recruitment of principals for government schools is happening after a decade. The previous batch of 58 Principals took their written exam in 2012 and joined the schools in 2015 after the completion of recruitment process that began in 2010 and completed in 2015.

questions.question_hindi: 'द ग्रेट इंडियन एग्जाम डिबेकल' के शोध विश्लेषण के अनुसार, सीबीएसई (CBSE) जैसे स्कूल-लीविंग परीक्षा बोर्डों में मूल्यांकन मानकों का पतन मुख्य रूप से प्रत्येक विषय में पूर्ण अंक प्रदान करने के लिए किस सरल मीट्रिक पर निर्भरता के कारण हुआ है?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: According to the research analysis in 'The great Indian exam debacle', the near-complete breakdown of assessment standards across school-leaving examination boards like CBSE has resulted primarily from reliance on which simplistic metric for awarding absolute scores in each subject?
questions.explanation_english: The research highlights that the reliance on a simplistic metric—specifically a 101-point (0–100) scale for awarding absolute scores in each subject—has resulted in a near-complete breakdown of assessment standards across Indian board examinations.
questions.explanation_hindi: शोध में रेखांकित किया गया है कि प्रत्येक विषय में पूर्ण अंक देने के लिए एक सरल मीट्रिक—विशेष रूप से 101-बिंदु (0–100) पैमाने पर निर्भरता—ने भारतीय बोर्ड परीक्षाओं में मूल्यांकन मानकों को लगभग पूरी तरह से नष्ट कर दिया है।
key_facts: This brief aims to demonstrate how the reliance on a simplistic metric—of a 101-point (0–100) scale for awarding absolute scores in each subject—has resulted in a near-complete breakdown of the assessment standards in Indian board examinations, largely because of the existence of multiple systems.

questions.question_hindi:
संघ लोक सेवा आयोग संयुक्त भर्ती परीक्षा (CRT) 2026 के अंतर्गत सूची-I (मापदंड/घटक) को सूची-II (संबंधित प्रावधान/संख्या) से सुमेलित कीजिए:

सूची-I:
A. दिल्ली में प्रधानाचार्यों की स्वीकृत क्षमता
B. विज्ञापित उप-प्रधानाचार्य (Vice-Principal) रिक्तियों की संख्या
C. CRT वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रश्नपत्र के अधिकतम अंक
D. साक्षात्कार हेतु निर्धारित अंक

सूची-II:
1. 475
2. 704
3. 300
4. 100

नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग कर सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Parameter/Component under UPSC Combined Recruitment Test 2026) with List-II (Corresponding Provision/Number):

List-I:
A. Delhi's sanctioned strength of principals
B. Number of Vice-Principal vacancies advertised
C. Maximum marks of the CRT objective paper
D. Marks allocated for Interview

List-II:
1. 475
2. 704
3. 300
4. 100

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english: According to the official exam guidelines for Advt. No. 51/2026: Delhi's sanctioned strength is 475 principals; the notification advertised 704 Vice-Principal vacancies (along with 124 Principal posts); the CRT objective paper carries a maximum of 300 marks; and the interview carries 100 marks.
questions.explanation_hindi: विज्ञापन संख्या 51/2026 के आधिकारिक परीक्षा दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार: दिल्ली में प्रधानाचार्यों की स्वीकृत संख्या 475 है; अधिसूचना में उप-प्रधानाचार्य के 704 पद विज्ञापित किए गए हैं; CRT वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रश्नपत्र के अधिकतम अंक 300 हैं; और साक्षात्कार 100 अंकों का है।
key_facts: Delhi's sanctioned strength is 475 principals, and for years the overwhelming majority of those chairs sat empty. The previous direct recruitment through UPSC filled 363 Principal posts on the strength of a test held in July 2022. At 828 posts, this is a substantially larger cycle — and the widest direct-entry route into school leadership that experienced PGTs and TGTs have had.

questions.question_hindi:
संघ लोक सेवा आयोग विज्ञापन संख्या 51/2026 के अंतर्गत सेवा शर्तों और आवेदन मानदंडों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. इन पदों के लिए ओबीसी (OBC) आरक्षण केवल राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र दिल्ली सरकार (GNCTD) द्वारा जारी ओबीसी प्रमाण पत्र के आधार पर ही मान्य है।
2. प्रधानाचार्य पद को समूह 'क' राजपत्रित, स्थायी, गैर-मंत्रालयी के रूप में एक वर्ष की परिवीक्षा अवधि (probation) के साथ वर्गीकृत किया गया है।
3. शिक्षण अनुभव प्रमाण पत्र तभी मान्य होंगे जब वे स्कूल के लेटरहेड पर सटीक पदनाम और निश्चित समयावधि दर्शाते हुए जारी किए गए हों।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the service conditions and application norms under UPSC Advt. No. 51/2026:

1. OBC reservation for these posts is admissible only against an OBC certificate issued by the Government of NCT of Delhi.
2. The post of Principal is classified as Group 'A' Gazetted, Permanent, non-ministerial with a one-year probation period.
3. Teaching experience certificates are valid only if issued on the school letterhead specifying the exact designation and the precise period.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct. OBC reservation is admissible strictly against certificates issued by GNCTD. The post is classified as Group 'A' Gazetted, Permanent, non-ministerial with one year probation, and experience certificates must state the exact designation and period on the school's letterhead.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। ओबीसी आरक्षण केवल दिल्ली सरकार द्वारा जारी प्रमाण पत्र के आधार पर ही उपलब्ध है। पद को समूह 'क' राजपत्रित, स्थायी, गैर-मंत्रालयी (एक वर्ष की परिवीक्षा) के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है, तथा अनुभव प्रमाण पत्र स्कूल लेटरहेड पर सटीक पद और अवधि के साथ होना अनिवार्य है।
key_facts: Experience certificates must be on school letterhead and must state the exact designation and the precise period — start collecting them now rather than at scrutiny stage. And OBC reservation here is available only against an OBC certificate issued by the Government of NCT of Delhi.

questions.question_hindi:
संघ लोक सेवा आयोग विज्ञापन संख्या 51/2026 के अंतर्गत संयुक्त भर्ती परीक्षा (CRT) की योजना और संचालन नियमों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रश्नपत्र में अनुत्तरित (unattempted) प्रश्नों के लिए, उस प्रश्न हेतु निर्धारित अंकों का एक-तिहाई अंक नकारात्मक अंकन के रूप में काटा जाएगा।
2. CRT पूरे भारत में पंद्रह परीक्षा केंद्रों पर आयोजित की जानी निर्धारित है, जिनमें दिसपुर (गुवाहाटी) और पोर्ट ब्लेयर भी शामिल हैं।
3. ₹25 का आवेदन शुल्क केवल सामान्य, ओबीसी और ईडब्ल्यूएस पुरुष उम्मीदवारों के लिए अनिवार्य है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the scheme and operational rules of the Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) under UPSC Advt. No. 51/2026, consider the following statements:

1. For unattempted questions in the objective paper, one-third of the marks assigned to that question are deducted as a negative marking penalty.
2. The CRT is scheduled to be conducted at fifteen test centres across India, including Dispur (Guwahati) and Port Blair.
3. The application fee of ₹25 is mandated only for General, OBC, and EWS male candidates.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is incorrect because there is 'No penalty' for unattempted questions. Statement 2 is correct as the test is scheduled at 15 centres including Dispur (Guwahati) and Port Blair. Statement 3 is correct because ₹25 fee is payable by General/OBC/EWS male only, while Women, SC, ST, and PwBD are exempt.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि अनुत्तरित (unattempted) प्रश्नों पर कोई दंड/नकारात्मक अंकन नहीं है (No penalty)। कथन 2 सही है क्योंकि परीक्षा दिसपुर (गुवाहाटी) और पोर्ट ब्लेयर सहित 15 केंद्रों पर निर्धारित है। कथन 3 सही है क्योंकि ₹25 का आवेदन शुल्क केवल सामान्य/ओबीसी/ईडब्ल्यूएस पुरुष उम्मीदवारों के लिए है, जबकि अन्य को छूट प्राप्त है।
key_facts:
Application fee | ₹25 General/OBC/EWS male only. Women, SC, ST, PwBD exempt

The CRT is scheduled at fifteen centres: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi and Visakhapatnam. UPSC notes the list may change.

questions.question_hindi: जुलाई 2022 में दिल्ली के उपमुख्यमंत्री मनीष सिसोदिया ने संघ लोक सेवा आयोग (UPSC) के किस अध्यक्ष को पत्र लिखकर आग्रह किया था कि दिल्ली के स्कूल प्रधानाचार्यों की चयन प्रक्रिया में व्यापक क्षमताओं और बाल व्यवहार की गहरी समझ का आकलन किया जाना चाहिए?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: To which Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Chairman did Delhi Deputy Chief Minister Manish Sisodia write in July 2022, urging that the selection process for Delhi school principals should assess larger abilities and a deep understanding of child behaviour?
questions.explanation_english: In July 2022, Deputy Chief Minister Manish Sisodia wrote to UPSC Chairman Manoj Soni suggesting that the commission look out for candidates' larger abilities and deep understanding of child behaviour during the principal recruitment drive.
questions.explanation_hindi: जुलाई 2022 में उपमुख्यमंत्री मनीष सिसोदिया ने यूपीएससी के अध्यक्ष मनोज सोनी को पत्र लिखकर सुझाव दिया था कि प्रधानाचार्य भर्ती के दौरान उम्मीदवारों की व्यापक क्षमताओं और बाल व्यवहार की गहरी समझ को भी परखा जाना चाहिए।

questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। परीक्षा मूल रूप से 1 नवंबर 2026 से बदलकर 9 जनवरी 2027 (सुबह 9:30 से 11:30) कर दी गई थी। यह निर्णय GSTA के महासचिव अजय वीर यादव के अनुरोध पर लिया गया, क्योंकि शिक्षक विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) के तहत बूथ लेवल ऑफिसर (BLO) के कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन कर रहे थे।

key_facts: 9.2.1 Head of the School/Principal will be the ex-officio. questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the financial, store procurement, and record-keeping rules under Clause 9.2 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws 2018, consider the following statements:

1. In the case of an unaided school, the Principal may perform only such functions as drawing and disbursing officer as may be specified in instructions issued by the Society.
2. Stores purchased for the school must be entered in the stock register, and the Principal shall scrutinize the bills and make payments.
3. The Principal is permitted to conduct physical verification of school property and stock once every three years.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because Clause 9.2.8 specifically states that the Principal must 'Conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once a year' (not once every three years). Clause 9.2.4 provides the condition for unaided schools regarding drawing and disbursing powers, and Clause 9.2.7 mandates entering purchases in the stock register, scrutinizing bills, and making payments.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि क्लॉज 9.2.8 में स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया है कि प्रधानाचार्य को 'वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार विद्यालय की संपत्ति और स्टॉक का भौतिक सत्यापन' करना होगा (तीन वर्ष में एक बार नहीं)। क्लॉज 9.2.4 गैर-सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों में आहरण व संवितरण कार्यों के नियम तय करता है और क्लॉज 9.2.7 स्टॉक रजिस्टर में प्रविष्टि, बिलों की जांच और भुगतान का प्रावधान करता है।
key_facts: 9.2.4 Be the drawing and disbursing officer for the employees of the school however in the case of an unaided school, he may perform only such function, as drawing and disbursing officer as may be specified in the instructions issued by the Society... 9.2.7 Make purchases of stores and other materials required for the school in accordance with the rules governing such purchases and enter all such stores in stock register and shall scrutinize the bills and make payments... 9.2.8 Conduct physical verification of school property and stock at least once a year and ensure the maintenance of stock registers neatly and accurately.

1. निपुण भारत मिशन के तहत, विद्या प्रवेश को देश भर में कक्षा 1 के सभी छात्रों के लिए तीन महीने के स्कूल-तैयारी मॉड्यूल के रूप में लागू किया गया है।
2. जादुई पिटारा को 3 से 8 आयु वर्ग के बच्चों के लिए शिक्षण-अधिगम सामग्री (LTM) के संग्रह के रूप में तैयार किया गया है।
3. मातृभाषा में बुनियादी साक्षरता और संख्यात्मकता के लिए 121 स्थानीय भाषाओं में प्राइमर विकसित किए गए हैं।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the foundational learning interventions implemented under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, consider the following statements:

1. Under the NIPUN Bharat Mission, Vidya Pravesh is implemented nationwide as a three-month school-readiness module for all Grade 1 students.
2. Jaadui Pitara is designed as a collection of Learning Teaching Material (LTM) for children in the 3 to 8 age group.
3. Primers for foundational literacy and numeracy in mother tongue have been developed in 121 Local Languages.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: According to the official Lok Sabha statement by the Ministry of Education, all three statements are correct: (1) Vidya Pravesh is a three-month school-readiness module for all Grade 1 students; (2) Jaadui Pitara is a collection of Learning Teaching Material (LTM) & e-Jaadui Pitara for children in the 3–8 age group; and (3) Primers have been developed in 121 Local Languages for foundational literacy and numeracy in mother tongue.
questions.explanation_hindi: शिक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा दिए गए आधिकारिक लोकसभा वक्तव्य के अनुसार, तीनों कथन सही हैं: (1) विद्या प्रवेश कक्षा 1 के सभी छात्रों के लिए तीन महीने का स्कूल-तैयारी मॉड्यूल है; (2) जादुई पिटारा 3-8 आयु वर्ग के बच्चों के लिए शिक्षण-अधिगम सामग्री (LTM) और ई-जादुई पिटारा का संग्रह है; तथा (3) मातृभाषा में बुनियादी साक्षरता और संख्यात्मकता हेतु 121 स्थानीय भाषाओं में प्राइमर विकसित किए गए हैं।
key_facts: These include nationwide implementation of Vidya Pravesh, a three-month school-readiness module for all Grade 1 students; large-scale teacher and school head training through NISHTHA (National Initiative for School Heads' and Teachers' Holistic Advancement)-FLN focusing on activity-based and child-centric pedagogy; provision of play-based and digital learning resources such as DIKSHA (Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing)- FLN content, Jaadui Pitara- a collection of Learning Teaching Material (LTM) & e-Jaadui Pitara for children in the 3–8 age group, Primers developed in 121 Local Languages for foundational literacy and numeracy in mother tongue and teaching learning material for students.

पीएम श्री विद्यालय (PM ScHools for Rising India) योजना के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. पीएम श्री विद्यालय राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 के सभी घटकों को प्रदर्शित करेंगे और अपने आसपास के अन्य विद्यालयों को मार्गदर्शन (मेंटरशिप) प्रदान करेंगे।

3. यह योजना मौजूदा सरकारी स्कूलों को सुदृढ़ करने के बजाय विशेष रूप से पूरी तरह से नए ग्रीनफील्ड स्कूल स्थापित करने पर केंद्रित है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the scheme of PM SHRI Schools (PM ScHools for Rising India), consider the following statements:

1. PM SHRI Schools will showcase all components of the National Education Policy 2020 and provide mentorship to other schools in their vicinity.
2. The PM SHRI Schools will be developed as Green schools incorporating features like solar panels, nutrition gardens with natural farming, and waste management.
3. The scheme focuses exclusively on setting up entirely new greenfield schools rather than strengthening existing government schools.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the scheme develops PM SHRI Schools 'by strengthening select existing schools being managed by Central Government/ State/ UT Government/ local bodies', rather than establishing completely new greenfield schools.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि यह योजना पूरी तरह से नए स्कूल स्थापित करने के बजाय 'केंद्र सरकार/राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश सरकार/स्थानीय निकायों द्वारा प्रबंधित चुनिंदा मौजूदा स्कूलों को मजबूत करके' पीएम श्री स्कूलों का विकास करती है।
key_facts: This will be a new scheme for development of more than 14500 schools across the country as PM SHRI Schools by strengthening select existing schools being managed by Central Government/ State/ UT Government/ local bodies. PM SHRI Schools will showcase all components of the National Education Policy 2020, act as exemplar schools and also offer mentorship to other schools in their vicinity.

questions.question_hindi: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के अनुरूप शिक्षा मंत्रालय की पहलों के अनुसार, केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना 'ULLAS' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: As per the Ministry of Education's initiatives aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, what is the full form of the centrally sponsored scheme 'ULLAS'?
options_english: Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society
Universal Literacy and Lifelong Advancement Scheme
Universal Lifelong Learning and Academic Standards
Unified Learning Leadership for Adult Society
questions.explanation_english: As stated by the Ministry of Education in the Lok Sabha reply, the centrally sponsored scheme ULLAS stands for 'Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society'.
questions.explanation_hindi: लोकसभा में शिक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा दिए गए उत्तर के अनुसार, केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना ULLAS का पूर्ण रूप 'Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society' है।
key_facts: Several initiatives have been taken and the centrally sponsored schemes namely, Samagra Shiksha, PM Schools for Rising India (PM SHRI), Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN) and Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society (ULLAS) have been aligned with the objectives and vision of NEP 2020.
